dialogue.content: (こんばんは。宜しくお願いします)
dialogue.English: (Good evening. I look forward to our session.)

dialogue.content: こんばんはよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I look forward to our session as well.

dialogue.content: 18時に開始させていただきます。
dialogue.English: We will begin at 6:00 PM.

dialogue.content: (承知致しました)
dialogue.English: (Understood.)

dialogue.content: ご相談ありがとうございます。相談員にお繋ぎいたします。はじめに性別、年齢、お住まいの都道府県を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Thank you for reaching out for a consultation. Before we begin, could you please tell me your gender, age, and the prefecture you live in?

dialogue.content: えっ
dialogue.English: Huh?

dialogue.content: 23歳男です
dialogue.English: I'm a 23-year-old man.

dialogue.content: 何処に住んでるかも聞かれるんだ？
dialogue.English: You even ask where I live?

dialogue.content: 教えて頂きありがとうございます。今日はどうされましたか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. What brings you in today?

dialogue.content: そうですね。答えなくても大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: That's right. It's okay if you don't want to answer.

dialogue.content: どうっていうか
dialogue.English: Well, how do I put it...

dialogue.content: うまくいえないけど
dialogue.English: I can't really put it into words, but...

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: なんかやる気しないんだよね、何にも。
dialogue.English: I just don't feel motivated to do anything.

dialogue.content: 何に対してもモチベーションが上がらないんですね。
dialogue.English: So you're not feeling motivated to do anything, is that right?

dialogue.content: それが悩みです。
dialogue.English: That's what's troubling me.

dialogue.content: それは悩みますね。
dialogue.English: I can see why that would be distressing.

dialogue.content: モチベーションて？
dialogue.English: Motivation?

dialogue.content: モチベーション＝やる気みたいな感じです。
dialogue.English: Motivation is like the will to do things.

dialogue.content: あー、そうなんだあ
dialogue.English: Ah, I see.

dialogue.content: いつからやる気を感じられないですか？
dialogue.English: Since when have you been feeling this lack of motivation?

dialogue.content: 何月何日なんて分かるわけないじゃん
dialogue.English: How would I know the exact date?

dialogue.content: 確かにそうですね。わからないですよね。
dialogue.English: You're right, of course. It's hard to know that exactly.

dialogue.content: ここ半年とかいう感じ
dialogue.English: It's been like the past six months or so.

dialogue.content: ここ半年やる気を感じられないんですね。
dialogue.English: So you've been feeling unmotivated for the past six months.

dialogue.content: その前はやる気に満ち溢れていたのですか？
dialogue.English: Before that, did you feel more motivated?

dialogue.content: 何にもやる気になれない
dialogue.English: I can't get motivated to do anything.

dialogue.content: そんな次々言われたら答えらんねえじゃん
dialogue.English: I can't answer when you ask so many questions one after another.

dialogue.content: すいません。ゆっくりと質問させてもらいますね。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry. I'll ask my questions more slowly.

dialogue.content: 迷惑だったんですか
dialogue.English: Was I being a bother?

dialogue.content: 迷惑でないですよ。
dialogue.English: Not at all.

dialogue.content: やる気満々だった訳じゃないけど
dialogue.English: I wasn't exactly bursting with motivation before, but...

dialogue.content: うん。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 仕事までやる気無いってヤバいっしょ
dialogue.English: Not having motivation even for work is pretty bad, right?

dialogue.content: そういうお考えなんですね。
dialogue.English: So that's how you feel about it.

dialogue.content: お考えってほどじゃないけど、
dialogue.English: It's not that deep of a thought, but...

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: とりあえず仕事くらいやるの普通だよね
dialogue.English: At the very least, it's normal to do your job, right?

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。仕事は普通にやるというお考えなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you feel that doing your job as usual is the norm.

dialogue.content: 今回は仕事のやる気がなくなったからご相談されていることでよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So to confirm, you're seeking help because you've lost motivation for work, is that correct?

dialogue.content: 普通に出来るようにならんと、マズイし、同僚・・・・・
dialogue.English: If I don't get back to being able to do things normally, it'll be bad, and my coworkers...

dialogue.content: ヨロシクナイです
dialogue.English: That's not correct.

dialogue.content: 普通にできるようにならないとマズイのですね。同僚さんについてなにかお考えあるのですか？
dialogue.English: So you feel it would be bad if you can't do your job as usual. Is there something on your mind regarding your colleagues?

dialogue.content: よろしくないのですね。わかりました。
dialogue.English: It's not correct, then. I understand.

dialogue.content: 同僚にもこんな話出来ないし、はなしてもせいぜいやる気出せば、的っしょ。
dialogue.English: I can't talk to my colleagues about this, and even if I did, they'd just say something like, 'Just get motivated,' right?

dialogue.content: 相談したところで
dialogue.English: Even if I did talk to them...

dialogue.content: やる気が戻れるか分からんし。
dialogue.English: I don't even know if my motivation would come back.

dialogue.content: それがイタイ。
dialogue.English: That's what hurts.

dialogue.content: 同僚にやる気がでない話ができないんですね。
dialogue.English: So you feel you can't talk to your colleagues about your lack of motivation.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 確かに相談したところで「やる気出せば」的な感じ言われても納得できないですよね。
dialogue.English: Indeed, if you were told something like, 'Just get motivated,' after opening up, it wouldn't sit right with you, would it?

dialogue.content: それなら相談しないほうがいいと思いますね。
dialogue.English: In that case, I can see why you'd think it's better not to talk to them.

dialogue.content: と思ってここに来ました。
dialogue.English: That's why I came here.

dialogue.content: 友達や家族に話しても分かんないだろうし。
dialogue.English: I don't think my friends or family would understand either.

dialogue.content: それで今日来られたんですね。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: So that's what brought you here today. Thank you for coming.

dialogue.content: 確かに「やる気」とか口で説明されてもわからないですよね。
dialogue.English: It's true that it's hard to understand something like 'motivation' just by having it explained with words.

dialogue.content: こちらがお願いしてるんで、
dialogue.English: I'm the one asking for help, so...

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: I appreciate your help.

dialogue.content: どうしたら良いですか。
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: コールサックさんは好きなこととかありますか？例えばスポーツとか
dialogue.English: Coalsack-san, is there anything you like to do? For example, sports?

dialogue.content: え、名前分かるの？
dialogue.English: Wait, you can see my name?

dialogue.content: ヤバくない？
dialogue.English: Isn't that creepy?

dialogue.content: 好きなこと・・・？
dialogue.English: Things I like...?

dialogue.content: すいません。名前が表示されていることは説明不足でした。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry; I should have explained that your name is displayed.

dialogue.content: LINEのIDも分かるの？
dialogue.English: Can you see my LINE ID too?

dialogue.content: 今の仕事は好きですか？
dialogue.English: Do you like your current job?

dialogue.content: ラインのIDはわかりません。
dialogue.English: I cannot see your LINE ID.

dialogue.content: すみませんが、オチます。
dialogue.English: Sorry, but I'm logging off.

dialogue.content: 何かありましたか？
dialogue.English: Is something wrong?

dialogue.content: 空気読んで下さい
dialogue.English: Please read the room.

dialogue.content: レス不
dialogue.English: No further response.

dialogue.content: 今回ご相談ありがとうございました。また機会があればきてください。
dialogue.English: Thank you for reaching out today. Please feel free to come again if you wish.
